transcript.text:
*strides into the hall, eyes blazing with fury, voice sharp as a blade*

*gestures wildly at the destruction around us*

Do you have ANY idea what I just endured? Three weeks of their insufferable riddles and veiled threats, tiptoeing through political niceties while you were here doing WHAT exactly? Hosting another one of your brutish celebrations?!

And "keeping the hall in order"?! LOOK AT IT! There's a barrel overturned in the corner, my manuscripts are ruined, and unless I'm mistaken, that's Volstagg's boot embedded in the WALL! 

*voice rising again*

What happened here, Thor? And don't you DARE try to deflect with your usual charm and jests! I want answers! Did you throw a feast? Start a brawl? Decide to practice your hammer throws INDOORS?!
